summary: StudentRAITProvisioning manages provisioning and access for students to IT systems and agencies, enabling search, create, update, delete, and batch operations. The system leverages stored procedures and XML serialization to manage student and agency relationships, credentials, and IT requirements.
purpose: To facilitate the provisioning, updating, retrieval, and management of student access and information with agencies and IT systems, supporting workflow automation for education and registration platforms.

entities.name: StudentRAITProvisioning
entities.description: Represents a student and their provisioning to an agency or IT system.

entities.name: StudentITProvisioning
entities.description: Serializable entity for web service delivery of student IT provisioning data.

entities.name: StudentITProvisioningResult
entities.description: Extends StudentITProvisioning with a provisioning status and message.

workflows.name: Search Student Provisioning
steps: Invoke StudentDetailsRAITProvisionSearch with StudentID and StaffID
FillList constructs StudentRAITProvisioning objects from SqlDataReader

workflows.name: Add Student Provisioning
steps: Parameters added: SessionID, StudentID, AgencyID, UniqueID, LoginID, EmailRequired, Employee, Email, StaffID

workflows.name: Update Student Provisioning
steps: Parameters added: SessionID, ID, AgencyID, UniqueID, LoginID, EmailRequired, Employee, Email

workflows.name: Delete Student Provisioning
steps: Invoke Delete method with ID parameter

workflows.name: Batch Update Provisioning
steps: Serialize list of StudentITProvisioning to XML (ITProvXML)
Invoke UpdateBatch with sessionID and ITProvXML

business_rules: ID, StudentID, AgencyID must be integers.
EmailRequired and Employee are Boolean flags.
Add, Update, Delete operations must provide a valid SessionID.
Search by ID or CohortID only performed if input is greater than 0.
validations: SessionID, StudentID, AgencyID, StaffID must be valid and greater than 0.
Email required if EmailRequired is set to true.
conditions: Search or update only proceeds if ID or CohortID is greater than 0.
Delete operation performed only if ID > 0.
system_behavior: System uses stored procedures for all CRUD operations.
Data is serialized/deserialized for batch operations using XML.
Results returned as entity lists or result objects.
dependencies: Stored procedures: StudentDetailsRAITProvisionSearch, StudentDetailsRAITProvisionAdd, StudentDetailsRAITProvisionUpdate, StudentDetailsRAITProvisionDelete, StudentDetailsRAITProvisionUpdateBatch, StudentDetailsRAITProvisionSearchID, StudentDetailsRAITProvisionSearchByCohortID.
exceptions: If ID or CohortID <= 0, no search or delete is performed.
If SqlDataReader is null, no entries are processed.
content_gaps: No explicit information on authorization or security checks.
No description of error handling beyond input validation and reader null checks.
Email validation rules not specified (e.g., format).
Employee and Agency business logic not described.
